title: Effectiveness of Generate→Validate→Repair Pipelines with Deterministic Verifiers on Multi‑Vendor Configuration Repairs (Repaired Preregistration)
research_question: Does integrating a deterministic network verifier into an LLM-driven generate→validate→repair pipeline reduce the rate of functional regressions and average blast radius of repairs versus LLM-alone proposals on a seeded multi‑vendor synthetic benchmark?
confirmatory_hypotheses: H1: The paired difference in functional-regression rate (LLM+Verifier+Repair minus LLM-alone) is <= -0.20 (i.e., verifier pipeline reduces absolute regression rate by at least 20 percentage points). This is the primary confirmatory estimand.
H2: The paired median blast-radius for LLM+Verifier+Repair is at least 30% lower than for LLM-alone (exploratory/secondary; reported with bootstrap CIs and nonparametric paired tests).
exploratory_questions: EQ1: Distribution of repair iterations required for verifier-guided repair (per-model/prompt).
EQ2: Relationship between topology scale/vendor-mix strata and mitigation effectiveness.
EQ3: Effect of prompt seed and LLM family on paired outcome heterogeneity.
benchmark_scope: Synthetic Cornetto-like multi-vendor topology generator (public, reproducible); seeded faults with ground-truth golden configs.
Topology scales: small (≤10 nodes), medium (11–50 nodes), large (51–150 nodes).
Vendor feature mix: common cross-vendor features (BGP, OSPF, static routes, ACLs, VLANs).
model_scope: Two hosted LLM APIs (distinct model families) labelled for preregistration as Hosted-LLM-A and Hosted-LLM-B; each evaluated with two fixed prompt seeds (total 4 model/prompt combos). Exact API identifiers and call settings will be recorded in the execution manifest and Disclosure Statement.
Temperature and decoding settings fixed per prompt seed; deterministic-call mode preferred when supported by provider; random-seed values preregistered.
transformation_scope: Config parsing → canonical intermediate representation (IR) for supported features.
Vendor-to-IR mapping for supported features (BGP, OSPF, static routes, ACLs, VLANs, VRF).
Automatic normalization of whitespace/ordering; deterministic stringify for verifier input.
primary_estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline (binary functional-regression indicator per task; estimand computed as paired difference: P(regression|LLM+Verifier) - P(regression|LLM-alone))
secondary_estimands: paired_median_blast_radius_difference (numeric: difference in per-task blast-radius between conditions; exploratory)
sampling_plan: We generate a stratified task bank of synthetic seeded-fault repair tasks using the Cornetto-like generator. Recommended (confirmatory) scenario S1: total tasks = 240 (discovery 40, confirmatory 200) stratified evenly across topology scales and vendor-mix strata. Alternative low-budget scenario S2: total tasks = 120 (discovery 20, confirmatory 100). Inclusion: tasks whose golden configs and seeded faults only require supported features (see verifier-supported feature list). Exclusion: tasks that require unsupported proprietary vendor features (automatically detected during dataset generation and relegated to an exploratory bucket). All inclusion/exclusion decisions are deterministic and logged; no human adjudication.
analysis_plan: Confirmatory analysis uses the supplied registered executor 'paired_binary_analysis_v1' to compute the primary estimand (paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline). Treatment of failed calls: primary executor will follow preregistered 'complete_pair_primary' (exclude pairs where both conditions fail model/API) and sensitivity 'complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity' (treat failed outputs as regressions). Paired binary test: McNemar-style paired-proportion inference via the registered executor; report 95% bootstrap CIs and p-values (alpha=0.05). Secondary analyses (exploratory): paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test for blast-radius, bootstrap CIs for medians, and descriptive repair-iteration histograms. All code, seeds, raw outputs, and executor inputs/outputs will be archived in the execution manifest.
multiplicity_plan: Primary confirmatory test: single primary estimand (paired regression-rate difference) at alpha=0.05. Secondary analyses are exploratory; when reporting stratified confirmatory-like subgroup tests (topology-scale strata), apply Bonferroni correction across the prespecified number of strata (3). All reported p-values will be labeled as adjusted/unadjusted.
missingness_plan: Model/API call failures, timeout, or corrupted outputs are logged and treated per preregistered policy: (1) retry policy: one automatic retry for transient API failures with identical settings; (2) if both original and retry fail, mark as failed call. For the primary paired analysis, exclude pairs where both conditions failed; include sensitivity analysis treating failed outputs as regressions (see analysis_plan). Missingness causes and counts will be reported. No manual imputation or human filling of missing outputs.

benchmark_names: Cornetto-like synthetic multi-vendor seeded-fault benchmark (generated programmatically; source config templates and generator code archived).
risk_factors: Verifier unsupported vendor features leading to untestable tasks.
Model prompt leakage across seeds if caching/memoization present in provider.
Dataset generator glitches that inadvertently reveal golden fixes in prompt templates.
detection_procedures: Automated feature-compatibility detector flags tasks whose golden config or seeded fault references unsupported vendor features (see verifier_supported_features below). Such tasks are automatically excluded from confirmatory set and placed into exploratory bucket.

Automated oracle comparison: for each LLM-proposed config, compute deterministic reachability/policy outcome using the golden-simulator pipeline (ground-truth simulation on golden baseline + proposed change) and compare to verifier output to detect verifier false-positive/false-negative cases without human adjudication.
item_flagging_rules: If a task references any unsupported vendor-specific feature (detected deterministically by the parser), mark as 'unsupported' and exclude from confirmatory analyses.
If model output cannot be parsed into IR (syntactic failure), mark the pair as a 'model-failure' and apply retry policy; if unrecoverable, follow missingness_plan.
If verifier returns 'unsupported' for a specific construct in a proposed config, automatically route the task to exploratory analysis and log the unsupported construct.
contamination_plan.analysis_treatment: Exclude unsupported-feature tasks from confirmatory analysis (they remain described in exploratory results). For verifier FP/FN measurement, use the automated oracle comparison between golden-simulator outcomes and verifier flags; report rates and perform sensitivity analysis reweighting the primary estimand by estimated verifier FN/FP rates.
residual_uncertainty: Residual uncertainty remains about proprietary vendor features not representable in the synthetic benchmark and their real-world prevalence.
Verifier coverage gaps may limit effect estimates to supported-feature subsets only.

budget_scenarios.description: Recommended confirmatory scenario: higher-power paired trial with 240 total tasks (40 discovery, 200 confirmatory), 2 LLM families × 2 prompt seeds = 4 model/prompt combos, max repair iterations = 3, deterministic verifier = Batfish (see preregistration).
budget_scenarios.feasibility_rationale: Model-call budget calculation: per task per model/prompt: LLM-alone = 1 call; LLM+Verifier+Repair = up to 1 initial + 3 repair iterations = 4 calls; total per model/prompt = 5 calls. 240 tasks × 4 model/prompt combos × 5 calls = 4800 max model calls, within capability_manifest cap (10k). CPU execution and Batfish sandbox run in Docker; no human annotation required.

budget_scenarios.description: Lower-cost pilot scenario: 120 total tasks (20 discovery, 100 confirmatory) with same model/prompt setup and max repair iterations = 3. Useful for exploratory validation and prompt-sensitivity sweeps.
budget_scenarios.feasibility_rationale: 120 tasks × 4 model/prompt combos × 5 calls = 2400 max model calls; fits under API-call budget and faster wall-clock completion. Recommended when rapid iteration is required; lower power versus S1.

power_plan.target_effect: Absolute reduction of 0.20 in regression rate (e.g., from 0.50 to 0.30), two-sided alpha=0.05, power=0.80
power_plan.clustering_unit: task (paired within-task comparison across conditions and model/prompt combos as blocking factor in secondary analyses)
power_plan.calculation_method: Approximate paired-proportion (McNemar-style) power approximation with conservative discordant proportion assumption. Using assumed discordant proportion ~0.30, sample size 200 paired confirmatory items gives ~80% power to detect an absolute paired reduction ≈0.20. Recommended scenario S1 uses 200 confirmatory pairs; pilot S2 (100 confirmatory pairs) reduces power (MDE ≈0.27).
assumptions: Baseline regression rate (LLM-alone) assumed ~0.50 for planning (conservative); discordant proportion ≈0.30 used for power approx.
Paired design (same seeded fault under both conditions) reduces variance; effect-size target chosen to match candidate hypothesis (≥40% relative; operationalized as ≥20 percentage points absolute).
Alpha=0.05, two-sided; bootstrap CI procedure for confirmation.
power_plan.minimum_detectable_effect_notes: With 200 confirmatory pairs (scenario S1), approximate MDE (absolute) ≈0.15–0.22 depending on true discordant proportion; conservative MDE used in planning is 0.20.
sensitivity_analyses: Recompute primary estimand under sensitivity: (a) treating unresolved model/API failures as regressions; (b) reweighting by verifier false-negative/false-positive rates derived from oracle comparison; (c) per-stratum power checks (topology-scale strata) with Bonferroni adjustment.

semantic_equivalence_checks: Round-trip test: golden config → IR → serialized → verifier input yields equivalent simulated forwarding state (deterministic simulation) for supported features.
Unit tests for each vendor-to-IR mapper on a set of canonical examples (automated).
automatic_rejection_rules: Reject any LLM output that fails IR parse (unparseable config) from confirmatory analysis for that model/prompt pair after preregistered retry.
Reject tasks for confirmatory set if their golden config or seeded fault includes unsupported vendor constructs detected by the parser.
transformation_validation.audit_sample_policy: Deterministic automated checks cover 100% of tasks; no human audit. A reproducible automated test-suite (unit+integration tests) will be run and archived.
transformation_validation.mapping_validation: All vendor-to-IR mapping code and unit tests are versioned in the experiment repository and executed in CI (Docker) before trial. Results and test artifacts archived.
residual_risks: Semantic gaps in vendor mapping for uncommon features remain and are captured by the unsupported-feature exclusion policy.

remaining_noncritical_uncertainties: Generalization to proprietary vendor-specific features excluded by the verifier-supported list.
Dependence of absolute effect size on the (unknown) true baseline regression rate across different LLM families and prompts.
Operational effect of verifier coverage updates over time; keeping verifier feature set current is an operational cost not modeled here.
